notes: §1985:VII.4.3.3 SR1 requires a refusal: "The REVERSED phrase can only be used with sequential files." BindOpen reads openFileSpec's REVERSED into BoundOpenTapePhrase.Reversed and screens it through CheckOpenTapePhrase, whose OpenTapePhraseRule row for REVERSED admits only a file control entry of ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL (COBOL2210 otherwise, and COBOL2211 outside the INPUT group, the only group the 1985 format writes it in); the screen has no edition arm, and 85 is the only edition where the phrase survives VersionConformancePass's 2002 removal gate. The witness refuses OPEN INPUT REVERSED on a relative file in sequential access; probes at --std 85 refuse it on an indexed file, refuse it under I-O on a sequential file, and accept it under INPUT on a sequential file.

next.reason: 1985: "The REVERSED phrase can only be used with sequential files."; 2023: "No REVERSED phrase in OPEN; only "The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only for sequential files."". The 2023 OPEN syntax rules cover INPUT, I-O, EXTEND, NO REWIND and sharing but never REVERSED. The phrase is dropped, so its sequential-only restriction goes with it.
